proposition: A cylindrical interface is useful when physical topology makes computational address, transform, visibility and authority directly readable rather than merely decorative.

layers.WORLD: external object/system being inspected or changed

observed: physical state readable at index line

reconstructed_transfer: Scale Lens: one identity may survive unequal lawful projections
RETURN: consequential operation leaves durable evidence
product-demo lineage: model/world correspondence must be measured rather than assumed
inspiration_not_provenance: Blade Runner / Memory-Orb association is a user-recognized visual/mechanical analogue; no recovered evidence establishes it as the historical source of the cylinder lineage.

body_mapping.aperture: outer sleeve/window reveals bounded addressed state; APERTURE changes window size/offset, never object identity
body_mapping.reference: fixed spine/index line makes state readable without software

invariants: Discrete semantic address and continuous transform are not interchangeable controls.
APERTURE reveals/selects scope; it does not silently mutate canonical identity.
ARM snapshots the addressed state and transform before RUN.
RUN acts only on the latched packet and emits RETURN.
Bridge packets traverse the same provenance path as human interaction.
Physical promotion requires state readback without software.

first_physical_return.prerequisite: Use the already recovered one-MODE-ring diagnostic packet before fabricating the whole body.
first_physical_return.then: Add one opaque sliding/rotating sleeve with a literal window over a printed state field; keep it passive.
first_physical_return.question: Can a person inspect, save, disturb, and restore an addressed state from the object itself without software?
first_physical_return.no_claim: No sensing, haptics, model-fit or low-translation advantage is established until measured.
